originalFindings.title: RFI-017 formal response and design detail required to validate informal instruction
originalFindings.observation: The Design Team has not issued a formal written response to RFI-017 or a specific drawing revision number, despite the superintendent noting the RFI as 'resolved' and the crew relying on an informal message to 'use original detail'.
originalFindings.consequence: Proceeding with reinforcement installation based on an informal message creates a compliance gap where the structural work lacks a verifiable authorized design directive.
originalFindings.action: Design Team must issue a formal RFI-017 response citing the specific drawing revision number, and the GC must confirm receipt to the subcontractor before further placement.
originalFindings.uncertainty: The superintendent's report (DR-A09) states the RFI is resolved and the pour used the approved detail, but no formal response attachment or drawing revision number is provided to substantiate that the informal message was an authorized directive.
